@jonas network_center tie-break: pick the min-eccentricity depot; if several tie, break deterministically by the lexicographically smallest sorted list of that depot's incident edges (order-independent, not raw alphabetical). That's why the star resolves to 'C' and the line to 'B' — both central, decided by their edge sets. If your impl produces those two outputs, you're on the right rule.
